Your account pages

Save pages. Duplicate them anytime.

Sign in with Google to save the referral page you build above to your account, then duplicate it into as many versions as you like.

Step 1 — Find and copy your personal referral links
  1. Open Ibotta, go to the invite or refer-a-friend area, and confirm the reward currently shown in your account.
  2. Copy your personal link. Repeat this inside TopCashback and any food, grocery, delivery, or savings program that has approved you.
  3. Read the qualifying action carefully. Some programs require a first purchase or receipt submission—not just an account signup.
Step 2 — Turn this into your own referral page
  1. Paste your links into the builder above and add your name or brand.
  2. Choose Use my links in this session to test every offer button here.
  3. Choose Download my referral page to get a separate HTML page with your links built in. Upload that file to your own website host, then share the public URL your host gives you.
Step 3 — Share in a way that earns trust
  • Lead with a real shopping use case: a grocery list, a receipt routine, or a weekly meal plan.
  • Post one clear call to action: “Check the current offer and use my link if it fits.”
  • Share to people who asked for savings help—never spam contacts or promise guaranteed income.
  • Use the promotion studio below to create a disclosed caption and image for Ibotta.
Step 4 — Add Ibotta and other food offers responsibly

Start with two or three programs you actually use. Give each one a short benefit, your personal link, and the required affiliate disclosure. Check links and terms regularly, remove expired claims, and track which posts create qualifying signups. Earnings vary; the examples above simply multiply a $10 qualifying bonus and are not a guarantee.
